_about: Suetonius in English: Alexander Thomson's translation revised by T. Forester (Bohn), the Twelve Caesars with the Lives of the Grammarians, Rhetoricians and Poets, in Gutenberg's complete edition. The 14 single-life Gutenberg files are the same text and are not fetched. Latin-facing Loebs of 1930 or earlier added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row); the scan's printing was checked for a post-1930 revision notice where its title verso survives. Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
